games.title: WarGames: Missile Defense
games.tagline: Defend NORAD, Moscow & Beijing from incoming ICBMs.
games.desc: A retro Missile Command clone inspired by the 1983 film. Pick your threat level, read the defense briefing, then survive 12 escalating waves with radar sweep and WebAudio sound — no downloads.

games.title: Disk Defrag
games.tagline: Defragment the drive. Clear the lines.
games.desc: A puzzle where colorful blocks slide down from the top and you twist them to fill the empty spaces at the bottom. Complete a full row and the whole line clears — clear several at once for a bigger score. Easy to pick up, tough to stop, with a local high-score table and a sound toggle. No downloads.

games.title: Drone Hunt
games.tagline: Laser rifle. Drones. Don't hit the birds.
games.desc: A top-down laser-rifle shooter. Click to fire a green beam from your rifle, destroy inbound drones, protect the birds, and down the boss drone every 5th wave. No downloads.

games.title: Computer Chaos
games.tagline: Catch the parts. Fill the orders. Beat the clock.
games.desc: A catch-and-sort repair-tech game. Catch good parts to fill orders, dodge junk, survive chaos events \u2014 5 lives, 60-second rounds. No downloads.

games.title: SKYDRIFT
games.tagline: Neon bolts, drones and a high-score table.
games.desc: A neon retro arcade side-scroller. Fly an 8-direction ship, power-scaled bolt patterns, bombs, 6 drone types, combo x10, and a top-5 high-score table. No downloads.

games.title: Bit-Byte
games.tagline: Chomp the bits. Outrun the viruses.
games.desc: A classic maze chase. Gobble the dots, grab a glowing power pill to turn the tables and hunt the four chasers, and clear all 7 mazes to win. Simple to play, tricky to master. No downloads.

games.title: DATA BREAK
games.tagline: Pilot a tech ship. Shatter corrupted data blocks. Purge the system.
games.desc: A fast-paced tech-themed brick breaker. Pilot a maintenance ship, launch Data Scrubbers, and purge corrupted data from an overloaded system. Eight corrupted bosses, multiple ships, power-ups, and endless mode. No downloads.

games.title: BUG SWARM
games.tagline: Mainframe defense. Wipe out the digital pest infestation.
games.desc: A Galaga-style fixed shooter. Defend the core from waves of viruses, rootkits, and tractor-beam spiders. CRT filter, retro scaling, adaptive boss AI, and high-score table. No downloads.

games.title: NEON PILOT
games.tagline: Further into the neon world. 5 eras. 2 visual styles.
games.desc: A retro arcade side-scroller spanning 5 neon eras (1984-3001). Switch between Neon glow and Vector wireframe styles. 8-way movement, tracer bullets, formations, hidden targets, bosses, and adaptive AI demo mode. No downloads.

games.title: TECHNOBONK
games.tagline: Survive. Evolve. Bonk. Neon-drenched arcade survival.
games.desc: A Vampire Survivors-style auto-attack survival game. 4 unique classes, 15+ upgrades, procedurally scaling waves, boss encounters, persistent stats/achievements, minimap radar, and synthwave soundtrack. No downloads.
